MEGA links download on their own, and a pasted folder brings all of its files.

## ✨ Added

- **MEGA file and folder links download without JDownloader.** KnightLoader decrypts them as they arrive and checks each file against the checksum in its key. A folder link becomes one row per file with its name and size, and each subfolder becomes a package of its own. When MEGA's free transfer quota runs out, the download waits as long as MEGA says and carries on where it stopped. A debrid service or JDownloader still takes MEGA links when you move it above MEGA on the priority card.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **A pasted MEGA folder brings all of its files, with or without a debrid service.** 2.6.4 left the folder to JDownloader, and a debrid service took the folder link as a single file. Thanks to [@jirat-sumitanun](https://github.com/jirat-sumitanun) for the report and the video in [#147](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/issues/147).
- **A folder link JDownloader opens becomes its files.** The link check waited for exactly as many links as went in and ran out of time on a folder, so the folder stayed a single row.
- **A file from a folder that JDownloader downloads shows as done.** JDownloader filed it under the folder's name, KnightLoader never found it again, and the row stayed queued after the file had arrived.
